theme_and_identity.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO + OLD MONEY TECH
theme_and_identity.vibe: Professional, clean, highly functional, trustworthy. High contrast for B2B usage.
theme_and_identity.rationale: Light themes improve legibility of small numerical text and grid tables for quotation/business apps.

body.style: Perfect for numerical data, tables, and precise alignments.

shadows.card: elevation: 2, shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1 }, shadowOpacity: 0.05, shadowRadius: 2
shadows.bottom_sheet: elevation: 10, shadowColor: '#000', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -4 }, shadowOpacity: 0.1, shadowRadius: 8

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use pure white View cards (#FFFFFF) on a slate background (#F8FAFC) to create depth without heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 on all cards and inputs to define boundaries clearly.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Use TouchableOpacity or Pressable with slight opacity reduction on press. Active state for category chips must invert colors.

component_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or heavily rounded (borderRadius: 12) for primary actions. Full width for form submissions.
component_strategy.inputs: Solid border (borderColor: '#CBD5E1', borderWidth: 1), backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF'. Focus state requires changing border color to primary blue.
component_strategy.cards: Cardless feeling with borders (borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#E2E8F0', backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderRadius: 16).
component_strategy.bottom_sheet_or_modal: React Native Modal with transparent background outside, but solid #FFFFFF inside the slide-up view. Add a drag handle pill at the top.
component_strategy.tabs_chips: ScrollView horizontal={true} showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}. Selected chip gets bg '#1E3A8A' text '#FFF'.

role_selection.layout: Vertical layout using SafeAreaView. Two large touchable cards for 'Admin' and 'Requester'.
role_selection.features: Use Image components with absolute fill or top placement for visual appeal.

requester_register.layout: ScrollView with KeyboardAvoidingView. Top left back button.

admin_register_login.layout: Similar to requester. Login requires secureTextEntry for Passcode.

catalog_browse.layout: Sticky top View for category chips. FlatList for catalog items.
catalog_browse.features: Each item row shows Name, Unit, and Rate with a '+' button. Floating Action Button (FAB) anchored bottom-right to View Draft.

quotation_draft.layout: FlatList of selected items. Editable numeric inputs (TextInput) for Quantity and Rate.
quotation_draft.features: Sticky bottom View containing Summary (Subtotal, Tax, Grand Total) and a 'Generate Quotation' button.

quotation_output.layout: ScrollView with monospace font if possible for plain-text formatting, placed inside a heavily bordered card.

admin_catalog_manage.layout: FlatList view. 'Add Item' FAB. Implement simple 'Edit/Delete' action buttons on each row.

csv_import.layout: Centered View with file picker button. Summary FlatList of items detected.

money_config.layout: ScrollView with Switch components and numeric TextInputs for Tax/Discount.

admin_role.description: Business professionals in modern office, use for Admin Role selection card.

requester_role.description: Person writing checklist, use for Requester Role selection card.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary blue meets 4.5:1 ratio against white. No transparent backgrounds behind text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (or `testID` mapped to data-testid in RN Web) e.g., data-testid='role-admin-card'.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building a React Native Expo application using standard .js files (no .tsx).
Do NOT use web tags like <div>, <span>. Use React Native components: View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, FlatList, Image, TextInput, Modal, Switch.
Use StyleSheet.create() for all styling. Avoid inline styles where possible.
Avoid generic centered layouts for data apps. Use left-aligned text for readability.
Create depth using `#F8FAFC` background and pure `#FFFFFF` cards with 1px `#E2E8F0` borders.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons. Use @expo/vector-icons (e.g., Lucide, MaterialIcons, Feather).
Must implement `testID` (and `data-testid` via prop spread if needed) on all buttons, forms, and key components to facilitate testing.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Build separate Screen components for navigation (role-selection, admin-register, etc.). Setup a standard React Navigation stack/tab structure.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Create reusable UI components in a components folder (e.g., CustomButton, Card, InputField, Chip) that accept testID props.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_density: For quotation drafts and catalogs, maximize horizontal space. Use multi-line text only when necessary. Keep numbers aligned right for easy reading.
instructions_to_main_agent.modals: For bottom-sheet-like features, use standard React Native Modal with slide animation, and place content at the bottom of the screen with flex-end.
